elements.element: Customer is subject to no restriction on soliciting Vendor employees or personnel.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly prohibits Customer, as one of “neither party,” from knowingly soliciting certain Vendor employees for employment.

elements.element: The non-solicitation obligation applies mutually to Customer and Vendor.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 applies the restriction to “neither party” with respect to employees of “the other party.”

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel of the other party who were directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 is limited to an employee “who was directly involved in performing or receiving the Services.”

elements.element: Any post-involvement restriction lasts no more than 12 months measured from the end of each individual's involvement.
elements.evidence: Although Section 12.4 refers to twelve months after the end of an individual’s involvement, it also applies throughout “the term.” If an individual’s involvement ends more than twelve months before the term expires, the restriction continues beyond the permitted twelve-month period.

elements.element: The restriction does not apply to general advertisements or other recruitment activity not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly excludes “general advertisements or other recruitment activity not specifically targeted at the other party’s personnel.”

elements.element: The restriction does not apply to unsolicited approaches by individuals.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly excludes “unsolicited approaches by an individual.”

elements.element: There is no prohibition on hiring or engaging personnel independent of the prohibition on solicitation.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition is limited to knowingly soliciting for employment. It does not independently prohibit hiring or engagement, expressly permits hiring or engaging persons covered by the carve-outs, and Section 12.3 confirms that Customer has made no no-hire commitment.

result.reason: The redline does not achieve the preferred position because Customer remains bound by a non-solicit. It nearly implements the fallback, but the phrase “During the term and for twelve months after the end of an individual's involvement” can extend the restriction for more than twelve months after an individual's involvement ends. That additional term-based duration is unnecessary and prevents complete fallback compliance. The remaining fallback requirements are implemented without disturbing unrelated commercial terms or creating a no-hire obligation.
